description: Main source file for sensor data acquisition and display on an embedded device using Zephyr RTOS, configuring and reading from LSM6DSV16X sensor and related peripherals.

methods.name: lsm6dsv16x_acc_trig_handler
methods.description: Interrupt handler for accelerometer data ready trigger, fetches sensor data and increments trigger count.

methods.name: lsm6dsv16x_config
methods.description: Configures the LSM6DSV16X sensor's accelerometer, gyroscope, and optional external sensors with specified sampling frequencies and full scales.
